newsitem.title: USA: Genesis extends offer for Multicare.
newsitem.headline: Genesis extends offer for Multicare.

text.p: Genesis ElderCare Corp said Thursday it extended its tender offer of $28 a share for Multicare Cos Inc to August 15 2400 EDT/0400 GMT.

The company, which was formed by Genesis Health Ventures Inc, Cypress Group LLC and TGP Partners II LP to acquire Multicare, also said it received early termination of the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976 for the filings made in connection with the acquisition.

Genesis, which first announced the deal June 16, said Multicare shareholders had tendered 1.8 million shares by the close of business Wednesday. Multicare had about 36 million shares outstanding in the first quarter.
Genesis said it extended the tender offer to allow for regulatory approvals, on which the offer's consummation is conditional. It added it may extend the date again to obtain the approvals.
Multicare's stock traded at 27-3/8 Thursday afternoon, up 1/16, while Genesis shares traded at 34, down 1/4.
